Third-party browser libraries bundled for local document extraction.
JSZip 3.10.1 — https://stuk.github.io/jszip/ — MIT/GPLv3 dual licence; MIT terms supplied in JSZIP-LICENSE.txt.
PDF.js 5.6.205 — https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/ — Apache 2.0; see PDFJS-LICENSE.txt.
Unmodified distribution builds copied from the configured development runtime.
No CDN or remote document-processing service is used. Read files remain in the browser.
